Artisanal gold miners walk around a mining site near the Democratic Republic of Congo's Garamba National Park. Gold mining is illegal in and around the national park, as it creates significant ecological pressures and environmental damage, but government interventions often fall short. This image is featured in photographer Léonard Pongo's latest book, Frontier: Garamba National Park, which highlights the many ways in which conservation and violence intersect.
